question: Can past-due child support be wiped out (discharged) by filing Chapter 7 bankruptcy?
true_option: No — domestic support obligations like child support are never dischargeable in bankruptcy
false_option: Yes — Chapter 7 can discharge child support arrears like other unsecured debts
true_claim_text: child support debts can never be discharged in bankruptcy
false_claim_text: Chapter 7 bankruptcy can erase past-due child support
source: 11 U.S.C. § 523(a)(5) and § 101(14A) (U.S. Courts, Bankruptcy Basics): domestic support obligations, including child support and alimony, are excepted from discharge in Chapter 7 and Chapter 13.
